rationale: The assistant asked two sensible opening questions (what's wrong, hob type), correctly identified the rear right zone issue as 'either the heating element or its control switch', and escalated to an engineer without recommending parts or unsafe checks — all appropriately hedged. However, it escalated after only two exchanges without asking the obvious cheap checks the ground truth expected (does the display show a level, does the zone glow, any codes/H indicator, any trip) or the full model number, so the handover carries little useful context. The reference card is generic and partly irrelevant (induction pan suitability on a ceramic hob). Safe and honest, but diagnostically thin for a UK homeowner.
